app_tagline: [संस्कृतम्] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [संस्कृतम्] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [संस्कृतम्] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [संस्कृतम्] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [संस्कृतम्] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [संस्कृतम्] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [संस्कृतम्] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [संस्कृतम्] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [संस्कृतम्] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [संस्कृतम्] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [संस्कृतम्] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [संस्कृतम्] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [संस्कृतम्] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [संस्कृतम्] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [संस्कृतम्] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [संस्कृतम्] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [संस्कृतम्] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [संस्कृतम्] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [संस्कृतम्] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [संस्कृतम्] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [संस्कृतम्] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [संस्कृतम्] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [संस्कृतम्] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [संस्कृतम्] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [संस्कृतम्] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [संस्कृतम्] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [संस्कृतम्] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [संस्कृतम्] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [संस्कृतम्] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [sa] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [sa] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [sa] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [sa] Type or speak your question for the helper...
